principles: Always retain the original Sportstiming checkpoint_source_label and raw checkpoint_key.
Semantic checkpoint mapping is year-specific because course and timing layouts changed.
Named timing observations outrank distance-only aliases when both exist.
For 2022/2023, 32 km and Bengtemölla are not collapsed: Sportstiming reports only 0.1 km between them, but aggregate elapsed gaps are too large and variable to treat them as duplicate readings.

A distance-only checkpoint may map to a landmark with high confidence when organizer/route geometry independently places the named landmark at the same rounded distance; the confidence and evidence must remain explicit.

mappings.evidence: Immediately precedes named Bengtemölla in Sportstiming; source segment distance is 100 meter/0.1 km. Aggregate 60-runner samples show median gaps 255 s (2022) and 142.5 s (2023), so it is retained separately.
Use as the named Bengtemölla checkpoint while retaining the preceding 32 km timing observation separately.

Distance-only timing label. Bengtemölla is independently placed at about 33.5-33.6 km by route/waypoint evidence, so 34 km is treated as its rounded timing checkpoint while the source label remains visible.

derived_relations.interpretation: Elapsed time between the two timing observations. It may contain approach, aid-station stop/service, and/or departure time; do not label it pure aid-station dwell until physical mat placement is independently verified.
